Wegolite — Oolite-derived asset licence notice
==============================================

The Oolite configuration files, models, and textures vendored under
third_party/oolite/, and every derivative produced from them at build time
(generated JSON content, GLB models, copied and baked textures), are derived
from the Oolite project.

Copyright (C) 2004-2024 the Oolite contributors.
Upstream project: https://github.com/OoliteProject/oolite

You are free to share and adapt the material for non-commercial purposes,
provided you give appropriate attribution to the Oolite contributors, indicate
what changes Wegolite made, and distribute your contributions under the same
licence.

These Oolite-derived assets are NOT licensed under the GNU General Public
License. The GPL-2.0-or-later licence of Wegolite's own source code does not
extend to them, and they must never be relicensed as GPL or MIT.

Wegolite is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with the Oolite
project, Frontier Developments plc, David Braben, or Ian Bell.
